name: cerulean
description: Cerulean — centralized certificate & DNS management: Let's Encrypt (regular + wildcard) via BIND/TSIG DNS-01, nginx proxy manager provisioning, Authentik SSO, vault, discovery, DNS auditing and certificate health scoring.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
